courses.description: Material and energy balances for single-phase and multi-phase processes common to chemical engineering. Phase equilibrium and analysis of reacting systems.

courses.description: Numerical methods are introduced and applied to the solution of chemical engineering problems. An introduction to chemical process simulation, and the appropriate software is provided.

courses.title: Chemical Engineering Thermodynamics

courses.title: Transport Process I
courses.description: Fundamentals of fluid mechanics and heat transfer. The design and analysis of equipment using the principles of fluid mechanics and heat transfer.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Fluid Mechanics
courses.description: The basic principles of fluid mechanics are introduced and the analysis and design of equipment using these principles is practiced.
courses.prereqText: CHBE 2100 (minimum grade C); MATH 2551 (minimum grade C) or MATH 2561 (minimum grade C); PHYS 2211; MATH 2552 (minimum grade C) or MATH 2562 (minimum grade C).
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 2100 Minimum Grade of C and (Undergraduate Semester level MATH 2551 Minimum Grade of C or Undergraduate Semester level MATH 2561 Minimum Grade of C or Undergraduate Semester level MATH 2X51 Minimum Grade of T) and Undergraduate Semester level PHYS 2211 Minimum Grade of D and (Undergraduate Semester level MATH 2552 Minimum Grade of C or Undergraduate Semester level MATH 2562 Minimum Grade of C or Undergraduate Semester level MATH 2X52 Minimum Grade of T)

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Transport Processes II
courses.description: Fundamental principles and applications of mass transfer. The analysis of chemical engineering processes and operations involving mass transfer.
courses.prereqText: CHBE 3130 (minimum grade C); CHBE 3200 (minimum grade C).
courses.prereqGT: (Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 3110 Minimum Grade of C or Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 3130 Minimum Grade of C) and Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 3200 Minimum Grade of C

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Heat & Mass Transfer
courses.description: Fundamental principles and applications of heat and mass transfer. The analysis of chemical engineering processes and operations involving heat and mass transfer.
courses.prereqText: CHBE 3205 (minimum grade C); MATH 2552 (minimum grade C).
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 3205 Minimum Grade of C and Undergraduate Semester level MATH 2552 Minimum Grade of C

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Separations Processes
courses.description: Fundamentals of equilibrium-stage and continuous contacting operations. Applications of principles to distillation, absorption/stripping, extraction, absorption, and other separation technologies.
courses.prereqText: CHBE 2140 (minimum grade C); CHBE 3215 (minimum grade C).
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 2140 Minimum Grade of C and Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 3215 Minimum Grade of C

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Chemical Kinetics and Catalysis
courses.description: The basic principles of chemical reaction kinetics, including rate laws, mechanisms, and heterogeneous catalysis are introduced.
courses.prereqText: CHEM 1212K; CHBE 2100 (minimum grade C); MATH 2552 (minimum grade C) or MATH 2562 (minimum grade C).
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level CHEM 1212K Minimum Grade of D and Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 2100 Minimum Grade of C and (Undergraduate Semester level MATH 2552 Minimum Grade of C or Undergraduate Semester level MATH 2562 Minimum Grade of C or Undergraduate Semester level MATH 2X52 Minimum Grade of T)

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Chemical Engineering in Nanoscale Systems
courses.description: Application of chemical processing fundamentals, fabrication, and characterization to design and analyze technologically important nanoscale systems. The course emphasizes an integrated engineering and science approach.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Chemical Engineering of Energy Systems
courses.description: Students will acquire the knowledge and tools to analyze CHP systems, traditional power generation, refinery and biorefinery configurations and advanced power generation and storage options.
courses.prereqText: CHBE 2140 (minimum grade C).
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 2140 Minimum Grade of C

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: The Science and Engineering of Microelectronic Fabrication
courses.description: An elective class for students interested in fabrication of semiconductor devices focusing on the fundamentals of materials synthesis, chemical and mechanical properties, and chemical reactions. Credit will not be awarded for both CHBE 4050 and CHBE 6050.
courses.prereqText: CHBE 3215 (minimum grade C); CHBE 2140 (minimum grade C).
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 3215 Minimum Grade of C and Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 2140 Minimum Grade of C

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Unit Operations Laboratory
courses.description: This course illustrates engineering/scientific principles and physical models important to the data collection/ interpretation of processes important to the practice of chemical engineering.
courses.prereqText: CHBE 3225 (minimum grade C); CHBE 4320 (minimum grade C).
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 3215 Minimum Grade of C and (Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 3225 Minimum Grade of C and Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 4320 Minimum Grade of C)

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Bioprocess Unit Operations Laboratory
courses.description: This course illustrates engineering/scientific principles and physical models important to the data collection/interpretation of processes important in biotechnology.
courses.prereqText: CHBE 3225 (minimum grade C); CHBE 4320 (minimum grade C).
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 3215 Minimum Grade of C and (Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 3225 Minimum Grade of C and Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 4320 Minimum Grade of C)

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Kinetics and Reactor Design
courses.description: Reacting systems are analyzed in terms of reaction mechanisms, kinetics, and reactor design. Both homogeneous and heterogeneous reactions are considered.
courses.prereqText: CHBE 3210 (minimum grade C).
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 3130 Minimum Grade of C and Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 3200 Minimum Grade of C and Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 3210 Minimum Grade of C

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Bioprocess Engineering
courses.description: Integrating several ChBE core concepts, bioprocess engineering applies the material to biological systems. Items covered are enzyme kinetics, fermentation, downstream processing, and integrated bioprocesses important to the biotech industries.
courses.prereqText: CHBE 3225 (minimum grade C); CHBE 4320 (minimum grade C); CHEM 3511 or CHEM 3521.
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 3225 Minimum Grade of C and Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 4320 Minimum Grade of C and (Undergraduate Semester level CHEM 3511 Minimum Grade of D or Undergraduate Semester level CHEM 3521 Minimum Grade of D)

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Reactor Design
courses.description: The basic principles of reactor design are introduced, including material and energy balances for homogeneous and heterogeneous systems.
courses.prereqText: CHBE 2140 (minimum grade C); CHBE 3300 (minimum grade C); CHBE 3215 (minimum grade C).
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 2140 Minimum Grade of C and Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 3300 Minimum Grade of C and Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 3215 Minimum Grade of C

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Process Dynamics and Control
courses.description: Dynamics of chemical processes and their control. Techniques of conventional process control as well as digital control.
courses.prereqText: CHBE 3225 (minimum grade C); CHBE 4320 (minimum grade C).
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 3215 Minimum Grade of C and Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 3225 Minimum Grade of C and Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 4320 Minimum Grade of C

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Process Dynamics and Control Laboratory
courses.description: Dynamics of chemical processes and their control. Techniques of conventional process control as well as digital control. Laboratory experiments would illustrate these concepts.
courses.prereqText: CHBE 4411 (minimum grade C).
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 3215 Minimum Grade of C and Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 3225 Minimum Grade of C and (Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 4320 Minimum Grade of C and Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 4411 Minimum Grade of C)

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Process Design and Economics
courses.description: Principles of flowsheet synthesis and economic analysis and optimization. A complete design on a chemical process will be undertaken, including concepts of unit operations, design, economics, and safety. Credit not allowed for both CHBE 4505 and CHBE 4530 (or CHBE 4520 ).
courses.prereqText: CHBE 4300 (minimum grade C); CHBE 4515 (minimum grade C).
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 3210 Minimum Grade of C and Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 3225 Minimum Grade of C and Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 4300 Minimum Grade of C and Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 4515 Minimum Grade of C

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Process and Product Design and Economics
courses.description: Basic principles of chemical process and product design including heuristic design approaches, heat exchanger network design, optimization, and economic evaluation. Credit not allowed for both CHBE 4510 and CHBE 4505 (or CHBE 4525).
courses.prereqText: CHBE 3225 (minimum grade C); CHBE 4320 (minimum grade C).
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 3215 Minimum Grade of C and Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 3225 Minimum Grade of C and Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 4320 Minimum Grade of C

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Chemical Process Safety
courses.description: Fundamental sources of chemical hazards and degree of risk. Process design and hazard avoidance are used to reduce risk.
courses.prereqText: CHBE 3225 (minimum grade C); CHBE 4320 (minimum grade C).
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 3215 Minimum Grade of C and Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 3225 Minimum Grade of C and Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 4320 Minimum Grade of C

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Chemical Engineering Capstone Design Project
courses.description: Basic principles of chemical process and product design including heuristic design approaches heat exchanger network design, optimization, and economic evaluation. Credit not allowed for both CHBE 4520 and CHBE 4505 (or CHBE 4525).
courses.prereqText: CHBE 4510 (minimum grade C); CHBE 4515 (minimum grade C).
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 4510 Minimum Grade of C and Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 4515 Minimum Grade of C

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Capstone ChBE Bio-Design
courses.description: Basic principles of chemical process and product design including heuristic design approaches, heat exchanger network design, optimization, and economic evaluation. Credit not allowed for both CHBE 4530 and CHBE 4505 (or 4525).
courses.prereqText: CHBE 4510 (minimum grade C); CHBE 4515 (minimum grade C).
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 4510 Minimum Grade of C and Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 4515 Minimum Grade of C

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Chemical Product Design, Engineering and Optimization
courses.description: Chemical engineering principles applied to the design of products.
courses.prereqText: CHEM 2312 or CHEM 2313; CHBE 3215 (minimum grade C); MSE 2001.
courses.prereqGT: (Undergraduate Semester level CHEM 2312 Minimum Grade of D or Undergraduate Semester level CHEM 2313 Minimum Grade of D) and Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 3215 Minimum Grade of C and Undergraduate Semester level MSE 2001 Minimum Grade of D

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Technical Leadership, Professionalism and Decision Making
courses.description: Technical leadership and decision-making approaches are covered alongside closely related characteristics of ethics and professionalism. These facilitate success in scientific and engineering organizations and careers.
courses.prereqText: CHBE 3215.
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 3215 Minimum Grade of D

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Complex Fluids - Microstructure and Mechanical Properties
courses.description: Complex fluids have interesting, practically relevant mechanical properties that arise from complex microstructures. This course covers fundamental physical principles, experimental characterization techniques and current topics.
courses.prereqText: CHBE 3200 (minimum grade C).
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 3200 Minimum Grade of C

courses.description: The course focuses on the fluid and flow aspects of micro and nano devices. It will cover basic micro/nanofabrication techniques, introduce transport of momentum and materials (including charged and magnetic materials) in small scale, and the applications in biology and medicine.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Pulp and Paper Manufacturing
courses.description: The course provides comprehensive foundational knowledge of the industry enabling the student to understand the role of diverse manufacturing operations and to strategically plan improvements.
courses.prereqText: CHBE 2140 (minimum grade C) or ME 3322 or MSE 3001.
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 2140 Minimum Grade of C or Undergraduate Semester level ME 3322 Minimum Grade of D or Undergraduate Semester level MSE 3001 Minimum Grade of D

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Emerging Technologies for Forest Bioproducts
courses.description: The course provides comprehensive knowledge of the manufacture of nontraditional products from forest biomaterials. It analyzes and assesses emerging manufacturing technologies, materials and products.
courses.prereqText: CHBE 2140 (minimum grade C) or ME 3322 or MSE 3001.
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 2140 Minimum Grade of C or Undergraduate Semester level ME 3322 Minimum Grade of D or Undergraduate Semester level MSE 3001 Minimum Grade of D

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Fundamentals and Challenges for a Sustainable Chemical Enterprise
courses.description: Life Cycle Inventory methodology will be explored as a means to develop new, sustainable products, materials and manufacturing processes.
courses.prereqText: CHBE 3130 (minimum grade C); CHEM 2312 or CHEM 2313; CHEM 2380.
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 3130 Minimum Grade of C and (Undergraduate Semester level CHEM 2312 Minimum Grade of D or Undergraduate Semester level CHEM 2313 Minimum Grade of D) and Undergraduate Semester level CHEM 2380 Minimum Grade of D

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Data Analytics for Chemical Engineers
courses.description: Introduction to data analytics and machine learning techniques for chemical engineers. Application of basic regression, classification, dimensional reduction, and clustering techniques to chemical data sets.
courses.prereqText: CHBE 2140 (minimum grade C) or MSE 2001 or ME 3322 or BMED 3310 or ISYE 3030 or ISYE 2028 or ECE 3025 or ECE 3040.

courses.title: Data-Driven Process Systems Engineering
courses.description: This course covers theory of optimization and data-driven modeling methods, and examples of data-driven decision-making in the chemical process industry.
courses.prereqText: CHBE 3225 (minimum grade C).
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 3225 Minimum Grade of C

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Biofluid Mechanics
courses.description: Introduction to the study of blood flow in the cardiovascular system. Emphasis on modeling and the potential of flow studies for clinical research application. Crosslisted with AE and ME 4757.
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level AE 2020 Minimum Grade of D or Undergraduate Semester level ME 3340 Minimum Grade of D or Undergraduate Semester level BMED 3300 Minimum Grade of D

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Electrochemical Energy Storage and Conversion
courses.description: An elective class for senior-level students interested in electrochemical storage and covnersion, including the fundamentals of electrochemistry and practical battery and fuel cells.
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level MSE 2001 Minimum Grade of D

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Biocatalysis and Metabolic Engineering
courses.description: This course provides an in-depth coverage of various topics in biocatalysis and metabolic engineering. Goals of this course are the development of an understanding of proteins as catalysts, their functioning in metabolic networks, their application in various industries, recognition of their potential for addressing future challenges in science and engineering. Crosslisted with CHEM 4760.
courses.prereqText: CHEM 3511 or CHEM 4511 or CHEM 3521; CHEM 3411 or CHBE 4300.
courses.prereqGT: (Undergraduate Semester level CHEM 3511 Minimum Grade of D or Undergraduate Semester level CHEM 4511 Minimum Grade of D) and (Undergraduate Semester level CHEM 3411 Minimum Grade of D or Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 4300 Minimum Grade of D)

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Protein Engineering
courses.description: This course covers the theory and practice of protein engineering methods, including specific examples of engineered proteins and their applications from the literature.
courses.prereqText: CHEM 3511 or CHEM 3521 or CHEM 4511 or CHEM 3522 or CHEM 4512.
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level CHEM 3511 Minimum Grade of D or Undergraduate Semester level CHEM 3521 Minimum Grade of D or Undergraduate Semester level CHEM 4511 Minimum Grade of D or Undergraduate Semester level CHEM 3522 Minimum Grade of D

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Pulping and Chemical Recovery
courses.description: Pulping and chemical recovery processes are studied on the reaction, delignification, energy, and liquor reuse. The process optimization, air and water pollution minimization are taught. Crosslisted with ME 4763.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Drug Design, Development and Delivery
courses.description: Introduction to the pharmaceutical development process, including design of new drugs, synthesis and manufacturing issues, and methods for delivery into the body. Includes student presentations. Crosslisted with CHEM and BMED 4765.
courses.prereqText: CHEM 3511 or CHEM 3521; CHBE 4320 (minimum grade C).
courses.prereqGT: (Undergraduate Semester level CHEM 3511 Minimum Grade of D or Undergraduate Semester level CHEM 3521 Minimum Grade of D) and Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 4320 Minimum Grade of C

courses.title: Pulp And Paper Lab
courses.description: Fundamentals of pulp and paper testing procedures.
courses.prereqText: CHBE 3130 or ME 3322.
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 3130 Minimum Grade of D or Undergraduate Semester level ME 3322 Minimum Grade of D

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Nuclear Chemical Engineering
courses.description: This course surveys the chemical engineering aspects of nuclear power. Topics include nuclear reactions, fuel cycles, solvent extraction of metals, the properties of actinides and other irradiated fuel materials, fuel reprocessing, and radioactive waste management. Crosslisted with NRE 4770.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Polymer Science and Engineering I: Formation and Properties
courses.description: An introduction to the chemistry, structure, and formation of polymers, physical states and transitions, physical and mechanical properties to polymer fluids and solids. Crosslisted with CHEM, ME, MSE, and PTFE 4775.
courses.prereqText: CHEM 2312 or CHEM 1315; CHEM 3411 or MSE 3001 or CHBE 2130 or CHBE 2140 or ME 3322.
courses.prereqGT: (Undergraduate Semester level CHEM 2312 Minimum Grade of D or Undergraduate Semester level CHEM 1315 Minimum Grade of D) and (Undergraduate Semester level CHEM 3411 Minimum Grade of D or Undergraduate Semester level MSE 3001 Minimum Grade of D or Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 2130 Minimum Grade of D or Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 2140 Minimum Grade of D or Undergraduate Semester level ME 3322 Minimum Grade of D)

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Polymer Science and Engineering II: Analysis, Processing and Laboratory
courses.description: Polymer fabrication processes and methods of characterization and identification of polymers are presented. Experiments in polymerization, processing and property evaluation of polymers. Crosslisted with CHEM, ME, MSE, and TFE 4776.
courses.prereqText: CHBE 4775 or CHEM 4775 or ME 4775 or MSE 4775.
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level CHBE 4775 Minimum Grade of D or Undergraduate Semester level CHEM 4775 Minimum Grade of D or Undergraduate Semester level ME 4775 Minimum Grade of D or Undergraduate Semester level MSE 4775 Minimum Grade of D or Undergraduate Semester level PTFE 4775 Minimum Grade of D

courses.title: Biosystems Analysis
courses.description: Analytical methods for modeling biological systems, including white-noise protocols for characterizing nonlinear systems. Crosslisted with BMED, ECE and ME 4782.

courses.title: Mechanical Behavior of Composites
courses.description: Stress-strain behavior of composites, property of matrix and reinforcing materials, mechanics of fiber-reinforced composites, lamina and laminate analysis, and mechanical performance. Crosslisted with AE, CEE, ME, MSE, and PTFE 4791.
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level ME 3201 Minimum Grade of D

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Composite Materials and Processes
courses.description: Basic principles of selection and design of composite materials and their manufacturing and testing. Cost factors. Laboratory exercises on manufacturing and tests. Crosslisted with AE, CEE, ME, MSE, and PTFE 4793.
courses.prereqText: CHEM 1310; PHYS 2212.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Technical Leadership, Professionalism and Decision Making
courses.description: Technical leadership and decision-making approaches are covered alongside closely related characteristics of ethics and professionalism. These facilitate success in scientific and engineering organizations and careers.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Chemical Engineering in Nanoscale Systems
courses.description: Application of chemical processing fundamentals, fabrication, and characterization to design and analyze technologically important nanoscale systems. The course emphasizes an integrated engineering and science approach.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Chemical Engineering of Energy Systems
courses.description: Students will acquire the knowledge and tools to analyze CHP systems, traditional power generation, refinery and biorefinery configurations and advanced power generation and storage options.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: The Science and Engineering of Microelectronic Fabrication
courses.description: An elective class for students interested in fabrication of semiconductor devices focusing on the fundamentals of materials synthesis, chemical and mechanical properties, and chemical reactions. Credit will not be awarded for both CHBE 6050 and CHBE 4050.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Advanced Chemical Engineering Thermodynamics
courses.description: Equations of state, corresponding states, and activity coefficient models and their relationship to intermolecular forces. Phase and chemical equilibria in chemical engineering.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Molecular Modeling
courses.description: Introduction to computational chemistry techniques for modeling substances at the molecular level, including: ab initio and semiempirical quantum methods, molecular dynamics, and Monte Carlo methods.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Electrochemical Engineering
courses.description: Electrochemical thermodynamics and kinetics. Corrosion. Applications to semiconductor devices, fuel cells, and batteries.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Advanced Transport Phenomena, Fluid Mechanics, and Heat
courses.description: Transfer Viscous fluid mechanics and convective heat transfer. Scaling analysis and lubrication. Stokes, and boundary layer flows. Transport about solid bodies. Linear stability theory.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Introduction to MEMS
courses.description: Introduction to Micro-Electro-Mechanical Systems: Microfabrication techniques including: photolithography, etching, physical and chemical vapor deposition, electroplating, bonding and polymer processing. Application to sensors and actuators.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Transport Phenomena-Mass Transfer
courses.description: Mass transport processes and material properties that affect them. Principles of both steady- and unsteady-state molecular diffusion are developed and transfer mechanisms examined.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Kinetics and Reactor Design
courses.description: A study of chemical kinetics and mechanisms in complex homogeneous and heterogeneous reaction systems. Design and analysis of chemical reactors for such systems.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Microelectromechanical Devices
courses.description: Introduces fundamental concepts and tools needed for the design, simulation and analysis of MEMS devices. These include electrical, mechanical, radiant, thermal, magnetic and chemical domains. Credit not allowed for both CHBE 6460 and ME 6460 or ECE 6460.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Mathematical Modeling and Analysis of Chemical Processes
courses.description: Formulation and solution of mathematical models of a range of chemical processes with an emphasis on differential balances and incorporation of uncertainty.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Complex Fluids - Microstructure and Mechanical Properties
courses.description: Complex fluids have interesting, practically relevant mechanical properties that arise from complex microstructures. This course covers fundamental physical principles, experimental characterization techniques and current topics.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Life Cycle Assessment
courses.description: Methods and applications for life cycle assessment of environmental impacts of products, services, and decisions, with process-based and input-output modeling for attributional and consequential analyses.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Microfluidics & Appl
courses.description: This course explores the fundamentals of microfluidics and nanofluidics, and their applications, primarily in biological and medical sciences (e.g. biomolecular separations). Credit not allowed for both CHBE 6710 and CHBE 4710.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Emerging Technologies for Forest Bioproducts
courses.description: The course provides comprehensive knowledge of the manufacture of nontraditional products from forest biomaterials. It analyzes and assesses emerging manufacturing technologies, materials and products.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Pulp and Paper Manufacture I
courses.description: The fundamentals of pulp and paper technology are presented. Applications to the several unit operations used are explored and augmented by field trips and recent case studies. Crosslisted with ME 6741, CHBE 6701 and MLDR 6701.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Pulp and Paper Manufacture II
courses.description: Papermaking technology is covered from a multidisciplinary engineering perspective with fundamental and practical considerations being addressed. Students participate in groups to run a pilot papermaking trial at the Henry Foundation in Savannah. Crosslisted with ME 6741, CHBE 6701 and MLDR 6701.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Fundamentals and Challenges for a Sustainable Chemical Enterprise
courses.description: Life Cycle Inventory methodology will be explored as a means to develop new, sustainable products, materials and manufacturing processes.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Data Analytics for Chemical Engineers
courses.description: Introduction to data analytics and machine learning techniques for chemical engineers. Application of basic regression, classification, dimensional reduction, and clustering techniques to chemical data sets.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Data-Driven Process Systems Engineering
courses.description: This course covers theory of optimization and data-driven modeling methods, and examples of data-driven decision-making in the chemical process industry.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Preparation and Reactions of Polymers
courses.description: A detailed treatment of the reactions involved in the synthesis of both human-made and natural polymers, including preparation and degradative reactions of polymer systems. Crosslisted with CHEM and PTFE 6750.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Physical Chemistry of Polymer Solutions
courses.description: Study of polymer solutions, polymer miscibility, adsorption, sorption, plasticization, molecular weights, molecular weight distributions, and interfacial phenomena using thermodynamics and statistical mechanics. Crosslisted with CHEM, MSE, and PTFE 6751.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Polymer Characterization
courses.description: This course introduces the student to surface, near-surface and structural methods of polymer characterization. Specialized techniques critical to physical structure are emphasized. Crosslisted with CHEM, MSE, and PTFE 6752.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Advanced Polymer Chemistry
courses.description: Advanced topics in synthetic polymerization methodology, polymer structure, and polymer properties in solution and the solid state.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Biocatalysis and Metabolic Engineering
courses.description: This course provides in-depth coverage of various topics in biocatalysis and metabolic engineering. Goals of this course are the development of an understanding of proteins as catalysts, their functioning in metabolic networks, their application in various industries, and recognition of their potential for addressing future challenges in science and engineering. Crosslisted with CHEM 6760.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Protein Engineering
courses.description: This course covers the theory and practice of protein engineering methods, including specific examples of engineered proteins and their applications from the literature.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Drug Design, Development and Delivery
courses.description: Introduction to the pharmaceutical development process, including design of new drugs, synthesis and manufacturing issues, and methods of delivery into the body. Includes student presentations. Crosslisted with BMED 6765 and CHBE 6765.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Polymer Structure, Physical Properties and Characterization
courses.description: Formulations and analysis of molecular and phenomenological models of elastic and viscoelastic behavior, development and description of structure, and fundamental aspects of structure-property relations. Crosslisted with ME, PTFE, and MSE 6768.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Advanced Biomaterials
courses.description: Advanced topics of biomaterials performance and engineering, including biointerfaces, host reactions of materials, and bio-inspired/smart-materials strategies. Crosslisted with BMED, ME, and MSE 6777.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Bioprocess Engineering
courses.description: Study of enzymes and microbial and mammalian cells for production of biochemicals and protein therapeutics in bioreactors; downstream separation and purification; integrated view of bioprocesses. Crosslisted with BMED 6779.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Cellular Engineering
courses.description: Engineering analysis of cellular systems. Crosslisted with BMED and ME 6782.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Systems Pathophysiology
courses.description: Overview of human pathophysiology from a quantitative perspective. A brief introduction to the application of quantitative models to the understanding of biological systems. Crosslisted with BMED, ECE, and ME 6793.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Tissue Engineering
courses.description: Biological, engineering, and medical issues in developing tissue-engineered constructs. Emphasis on the integration of these disciplines at a basic molecular and cell biology level. Crosslisted with CHE and ME 6794.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Pharmaceutical development: from drug lead to drug product
courses.description: We address the multifaceted process of bringing a drug from concept to market through open-ended, student-driven, collaborative projects addressing real-world problems in pharmaceutical development.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Are You Thinking of Becoming An Academic?
courses.description: How to run a successful research program, advise students, apply and get a job in academia, navigate promotion and tenure, and other aspects of academia.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Teaching Practicum
courses.description: Supervised teaching for doctoral students. Teaching techniques, course and curriculum design, student evaluation methods and criteria. Students may, in some instances, prepare and present lectures. Crosslisted with NRE, ME, HP 7757.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Mechanics of Polymer Solids and Fluids
courses.description: Continuum mechanics of solids and fluids; mechanics of deformation of anisotropic polymers; yield, breaking, and fatigue; non-Newtonian viscous and viscoelastic behavior of polymer fluids. Crosslisted with ME, MSE, and PTFE 7771.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Fundamentals of Fracture Mechanics
courses.description: Advanced study of failure of structural materials under load, mechanics of fracture, and microscopic and macroscopic aspects of the fracture of engineering materials. Crosslisted with AE, CEE, ME, and MSE 7772.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Fatigue of Materials and Structures
courses.description: Mechanical and microstructural aspects of nucleation and growth of cracks under cyclic loading conditions, notch effects, cumulative damage, multiaxial loading, and fatigue crack propagation. Crosslisted with AE, CEE, ME, and MSE 7774.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Manufacturing of Composites
courses.description: Major manufacturing techniques for metal, ceramic, and polymer matrix composites. Modeling of processes with emphasis on fundamental mechanisms and effects. Crosslisted with AE, CEE, ME, MSE, and PTFE 7793.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Seminar in Chemical Engineering
courses.description: Seminars involving current research projects presented by graduate students, faculty, and invited speakers.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Seminar in Chemical Engineering
courses.description: Seminars involving current research projects presented by graduate students, faculty, and invited speakers.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: CHBE 8801 Recitation
courses.description: Designed to provide time for application of conceptual knowledge and extension of instruction. Optional and non-billable.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Special Problems
courses.description: Special Problems for Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Teaching Assistantship
courses.description: For graduate students holding teaching assistantships.

courses.subject: CHBE
courses.title: Research Assistantship
courses.description: For graduate students holding research assistantships.
